author: sjm41
body:
Human HSD17B4 (P51659) is "Peroxisomal multifunctional enzyme type 2"

As the UniProt summary says:
Bifunctional enzyme acting on the peroxisomal fatty acid beta-oxidation pathway. Catalyzes two of the four reactions in fatty acid degradation: hydration of 2-enoyl-CoA (trans-2-enoyl-CoA) to produce (3R)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA, and dehydrogenation of (**3R**)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA to produce 3-ketoacyl-CoA (3-oxoacyl-CoA)


The dehydrogenase reaction is annotated with this RHEA/EC in UniProt:
[Rhea 32711](https://www.rhea-db.org/rhea/32711) = EC:1.1.1.n12:
a (3R)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA + NAD+ = a 3-oxoacyl-CoA + NADH + H+
Based on PMID: 9089413
This corresponds to GO:0106386 (3R)-3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity, which is not currently annotated to HSD17B4.

Instead, there are 6 IDA/IMP GO annotations are to this different, 3S-specific, term by SWIS and SWIE:
GO:0003857 (3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase activity = EC:1.1.1.35)
This is based on the same paper as above (PMID: 9089413) and 3 additional PMIDs.
That GO term corresponds to EC:1.1.1.35/RHEA:22432 and is specific for the 3S form.

I believe the UP summary and EC/RHEA annotation is correct, and the 6 GO annotations need changing to GO:0106386.

I have made a separate ontology ticket to improve the name of GO:0003857 (https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30577)

@marcfeuermann Note that this affects PTN008545657 - I think that should also be annotated with GO:0106386.
title: Human HSD17B4 (P51659) annotations

author: marcfeuermann
body:
Thanks to our magical new tool for creating primary annotations directly with PAINT, I was able to create the right annotation (GO:0106386) for human HSD17B4 and propagate it to the corresponding node. This means we don't have to wait months before we can process tickets of this kind.
Feel free to close this ticket if no further action is required.
Marc.

author: sjm41
body: Thanks Marc. I believe the P51659 annotations to GO:0003857 still need changing to GO:0106386, so I'll leave this ticket open.

author: Antonialock
body: I swapped the 6 annotations to GO:0003857 for  GO:0106386, for P51659
